## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting change, including limitations.

## Validation

List meaningful checks actually run, reproduction evidence, and any blocked checks.
Never describe mocked or skipped architecture tests as passing. Include UI screenshots
for rendered changes and the real gate report for changed boundaries.

## Compatibility and documentation

Explain migration/configuration impact, paused-run behavior, typed adapter boundaries,
and updates to ADRs, progress or setup. Confirm no credentials or local data are included.
